derivation: Decode the exact source MP3; sample-time atrim using its released matching word/verse clock; preserve each verse tail through timestamp_to; remove only the 40ms between selected verses; concatenate selected PCM; encode libmp3lame q2 without speed/sample-rate/voice transformations. No guessed timing from another recording. MP3 encoding may add encoder padding, never samples from a later word.

assessment.ilim: 20:114 word 14 ends and word 15 starts at 1325.365 seconds in the released timing data. Ten-ms source-energy windows around 1325.15–1325.37 contain continuous speech, not an independent silence gap. Starting at 1325.15, 1325.25 or 1325.365 does not produce reliable recognition of all three words. We cannot prove that the initial rabbi consonant is intact or that moving earlier excludes qul. Do not adjust the app clip by guesswork.
assessment.yolculuk: 43:13 word 11 has repeated source segments; its final segment ends exactly at 151.136, where word 12 begins. A lower-energy transition occurs approximately 151.11–151.23 but is not silence. Diagnostic starts 151.036 and 151.136 recognize the first phrase partially; this does not independently confirm all end consonants or the complete following verse. Candidate remains quarantined rather than claiming a boundary repair.
